sources.title: ByteYellow/AgentProvenance
sources.summary: Security-oriented three-axis observability for sandboxed AI agents: model intent, app context, and runtime telemetry into verifiable evidence graphs for risk, forensics, and audit.

sources.title: Delego-Dev/delego
sources.summary: Intent-bound action authorization for AI agents — deterministic, per-action approval a prompt injection can't re-point, with a signed, tamper-evident audit trail.

sources.title: FITPAC/FITPAC
sources.summary: FITPAC is an open standard for translating human intent into auditable, implementation-agnostic specs for agentic coding. Defines a shared ontology, control grammar, conflict precedence, ambiguity consultation, and round-trip verification (spec → code → derived spec → diff) to evidence alignment.

sources.title: crescerelabs/sentience-governor
sources.summary: Local-first runtime governance for AI agents. Declare intent, catch out-of-scope actions, and audit them in a verifiable trail.

sources.title: mattijsmoens/intentshield
sources.summary: Pre-execution intent verification for AI agents. Audits what your AI is about to do, not what it says. Zero dependencies, deterministic, hash-sealed.

sources.title: kylezantos/intent-engineering
sources.summary: Before the polish pass, ask what the page should make people do, notice, and feel. Start or audit a design from bedrock intent.

sources.title: lukeb-aidev/cohesix
sources.summary: Cohesix is an open-source research OS for trustworthy AI infrastructure. Built on the formally verified seL4 microkernel, its Queen/Worker hives turn AI intent into capability-scoped, bounded, auditable action across edge GPU fleets - “infrastructure for AGI.”
